This score determines whether the system enters production mode. The pricing model selection introduces a strategic binary choice that influences downstream behavior—either maintaining legacy structure or adopting new billing paradigms. Both primitives are governed by conditional dependencies: readiness must be verified before activation, and activation requires explicit user authorization. Failure modes arise from missing secrets, invalid API keys, or misaligned configurations. These failures propagate through the system as cascading blackouts in functionality, particularly affecting subscription flows and data ingestion pipelines.
